concept.name: Standardization
concept.definition: Feature-wise centering and scaling, conventionally subtracting the training mean and dividing by the training standard deviation.
concept.intuition: It controls what information the model receives and in what numerical representation.
concept.mechanics: Estimate mean and scale on training rows, store them, and transform every later row with those same values.
concept.formula: z = (x - training mean) / training standard deviation
concept.failure_modes: Fitting the operation on the full dataset leaks future information; revisions, outliers, and missing values can also distort results.
concept.misconceptions: A cleaner or rescaled dataset is not automatically more truthful; transformations must preserve timing and economic meaning.
concept.example: Training values 8, 10, and 12 have mean 10 and standard deviation about 1.63, so 12 maps to about 1.22.
